## Comprehensive Pinzo Admin UI Code Analysis

Based on my thorough exploration of the Pinzo admin UI codebase, here are all findings with line numbers:

### 1. **app.zip-codes.tsx** - ZIP Codes Management Page

**Upgrade Banners (Lines 998-1056):**
- Free plan banner: Lines 998-1016, title "Unlock more zip codes, blocked zones & CSV tools" with "View Plans" action
- Starter plan banner: Lines 1019-1038, title "Unlock unlimited zip codes, blocked zones & CSV export" with "View Plans" action
- Warning banner for at-limit: Lines 1041-1056, "Upgrade to [Starter/Pro]" action text varies based on current plan
- NO duplicate "Upgrade to Starter" buttons - each banner has different titles and contexts

**Status Stats Bar (Lines 1058-1135):**
- Shows in 5-column responsive grid: Total, Allowed, Blocked, Active, Current Plan info
- Lines 1062-1078: Total Zip Codes card with count and optional limit (e.g., "5 / 20")
- Lines 1081-1090: Allowed count in success tone
- Lines 1093-1110: Blocked count (disabled/greyed out if plan doesn't allow)
- Lines 1111-1128: Active count
- Plan info displayed alongside

**Upgrade text alignment:** Left-aligned (no centering) - action buttons are naturally left-positioned in Banner component

**Bulk Actions (Lines 969-975, 1393-1450+):**
- Delete Selected: destructive bulk action (line 971)
- NO "Select All" checkbox creates automatic row selection - checkbox is explicit UI element in IndexTable
- Action buttons (Edit/Delete) at row level do NOT trigger checkbox selection
- Row checkboxes are independent of action button clicks

**Edit Modal Behavior (Lines 1500+):**
- Modal opens for editing single zip code
- Form fields populated from selected record
- No flickering issue mentioned in code - standard React modal pattern with state management

### 2. **app.delivery-rules.tsx** - Delivery Rules

**Upgrade Banner & Button (Lines 445-459):**
